annotations.title: Get County Newspapers and Clerk Info

description: Returns a county's publication details: the newspapers on the NY State Comptroller's unclaimed-funds list for the county (for an LLC's notice, the county clerk designates the two newspapers), the county clerk's contact information, and which county a New York City borough is (Manhattan is New York County, Brooklyn is Kings County, Staten Island is Richmond County, Queens is Queens County, the Bronx is Bronx County). In Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens and the Bronx the county clerk assigns newspapers to each LLC. Use when someone asks which newspapers a county uses, how to reach the county clerk, or which county a borough is. Do NOT use for prices (use llc_publication_get_county_pricing), requirements (use llc_publication_check_requirements), or process steps (use llc_publication_get_process_guide).

county.description: NY county or NYC borough name (e.g. 'Queens', 'Westchester', 'Manhattan', 'Albany')
